Maya (CSM): Quick flag: NimbusCare monthly active usage collapsed ~58% in 45d. Renewal in 34 days. Procurement leaked they're running an RFP. Need triage and a rapid win.
Rohit (CS Ops): Yikes. Any clue if it's feature churn or cost pain?
Maya (CSM): Early signs point to both. Embeds ingestion jobs paused after budget reforecast. Summary: `embeds: -64%`, `batch_jobs: -80%`, `interactive/generate: -25%`. Seats: `30 -> 9`.
Eve (Solutions Eng): I can run a quick probe: quantized model option vs current baseline and projected monthly spend. If cost delta >15% they're likely to switch.
Ben (AE): I'll ping their procurement POC (L. Gardner) and ask for the RFP timeline. If we can offer temporary price protection or short-term reserved capacity it might buy time.
monitor-bot: Account drop alert logged: NCR-221 — drop >50% over 30d.
Rohit (CS Ops): Outreach plan suggestion: 1) Immediate email to procurement with light PO-friendly numbers, 2) Offer a 3-week reduced-rate pilot with sandbox data flow to show parity, 3) Provide enablement playbook to reduce integration lift.
Maya (CSM): Draft outreach: "Hi Laura — noticed some automated jobs paused which may be impacting results. Can we 30m this week to propose a low-friction pilot and cost reconciliation? Happy to involve an SE." Thoughts?
Eve (Solutions Eng): Good. For the SE session I need current avg daily tokens, typical sequence lengths, and top API paths. Maya, can you share or grant dashboard access?
Maya (CSM): Sharing access now. Quick snippet: `avg_tokens/day: 950k -> 410k`, `median_seq: 320 tokens`, `top_api: embed_bulk, summary_stream`.
Ben (AE): Procurement replied — RFP due in 10 days, demo panel next Tue. They're evaluating two other vendors.
Rohit (CS Ops): New risk: demo panel. We should prep a focused demo showing equivalent accuracy at lower cost per convo and the onboarding checklist. Also call out our fallback model profiles.
Eve (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a 2-slide cost analysis + a short script to show model-swap with quantized weights in the demo. ETA 24h.
Maya (CSM): Action items: Maya -> pull churn cohort and invite Laura to talk; Rohit -> build enablement checklist + playbook; Eve -> cost/quant sim and demo script; Ben -> secure seat on demo panel and ask for evaluation criteria. Let's huddle 8:30am PT tomorrow to align.
Ben (AE): I'll also float a bridge offer: 45d extension with 20% pilot discount if they commit to the demo.
Maya (CSM): Noted. If panel asks about uptime/SLAs, have SRE readiness notes ready.
Rohit (CS Ops): I'll bundle uptime and incident history and a short SRE blurb they can read before demo.
Eve (Solutions Eng): Will test the quantized variant on their sample dataset and include latency numbers.
Maya (CSM): Thanks — high priority. We want to avoid losing strategic health vertical.
Ben (AE): On it.
monitor-bot: Reminder: triage sync scheduled at 2026-03-25 08:30 PT.
